_comment: Documented divergences of the TS engine against the reference pipeline corpus. Fail-closed: a failing case NOT listed here is red; a listed case that now passes is red (stale baseline). Headline divergences: (1) the TS engine still blocks content-detection with the legacy 403 Access denied contract instead of the settled 400 Suspicious activity detected shape; (2) rate-limit blocks use the legacy Rate limit exceeded body without Retry-After; (3) the UA event name is ua_blocked instead of user_agent_blocked; (4) the on_block hook does not fire on passive/blocked paths with the reference payload; (5) global behavior rules are not processed (no behavior ban). The 4 geo country cases pass via geoResolver injection.
